__init__.py:
"""bimcheck: automatic checks for the Open Structural BIM Course exercises."""
__version__ = "0.1.0"
__main__.py:
"""Command line: python -m bimcheck <exercise> <files...>   |   python -m bimcheck list"""
import sys

from .exercises import REGISTRY

GREEN, RED, DIM, END = "\033[32m", "\033[31m", "\033[2m", "\033[0m"


def main(argv=None):
    argv = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    color = sys.stdout.isatty() and "--no-color" not in argv
    argv = [a for a in argv if a != "--no-color"]
    if not argv or argv[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        print(__doc__)
        return 0
    if argv[0] == "list":
        for eid, ex in sorted(REGISTRY.items(), key=lambda kv: [int(x) for x in kv[0].split(".")]):
            print(f"{eid:5} {ex['title']}   [{' '.join(ex['inputs'])}]")
        return 0
    eid, files = argv[0], argv[1:]
    if eid not in REGISTRY:
        print(f"Unknown exercise '{eid}'. Run: python -m bimcheck list")
        return 2
    ex = REGISTRY[eid]
    needed = [i for i in ex["inputs"] if not i.startswith("[")]
    if len(files) < len(needed):
        print(f"Exercise {eid} needs: {' '.join(ex['inputs'])}")
        return 2
    res = ex["fn"](*files)
    g, rd, d, e = (GREEN, RED, DIM, END) if color else ("", "", "", "")
    print(f"\nExercise {res.exercise}: {res.title}\n")
    for it in res.items:
        mark = f"{g}PASS{e}" if it.ok else f"{rd}FAIL{e}"
        print(f"  {mark}  {it.text}")
        if it.hint and not it.ok:
            print(f"        {d}{it.hint}{e}")
    ok, n = res.score()
    print(f"\n  {ok} of {n} checks passed." + ("  Exercise complete." if res.passed else ""))
    return 0 if res.passed else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Section 1: project setup, levels and grids."""
import math

import numpy as np
import ifcopenshell.util.placement as up

from .. import spec
from ..core import Model, Result, norm, same, fmt, POS
from . import exercise


def _dms(v):
    if v is None:
        return None
    parts = list(v) + [0] * (4 - len(v))
    d, m, s, ms = parts[:4]
    sign = -1 if (d < 0 or m < 0 or s < 0 or ms < 0) else 1
    return sign * (abs(d) + abs(m) / 60 + (abs(s) + abs(ms) / 1e6) / 3600)


@exercise("1.1", "Project, site, building, units and location")
def ex_1_1(path):
    m, p = Model(path), spec.PROJECT
    r = Result("1.1", "Project, site, building, units and location")
    proj = m.by_type("IfcProject")
    r.check(proj and norm(proj[0].Name) == norm(p["project_name"]),
            f"Project name is '{p['project_name']}'", f"found: {proj[0].Name if proj else 'no IfcProject'}")
    sites = m.by_type("IfcSite")
    r.check(any(norm(s.Name) == norm(p["site_name"]) for s in sites),
            f"Site name is '{p['site_name']}'", f"found: {[s.Name for s in sites]}")
    blds = m.by_type("IfcBuilding")
    r.check(any(norm(b.Name) == norm(p["building_name"]) for b in blds),
            f"Building name is '{p['building_name']}'", f"found: {[b.Name for b in blds]}")
    lu = [u for u in m.by_type("IfcSIUnit") if u.UnitType == "LENGTHUNIT"]
    r.check(lu and lu[0].Name == "METRE", "Length unit is metres or millimetres (SI)",
            f"found: {[(u.Prefix, u.Name) for u in lu] or 'no SI length unit'}")
    site = sites[0] if sites else None
    lat = _dms(site.RefLatitude) if site else None
    lon = _dms(site.RefLongitude) if site else None
    r.check(lat is not None and abs(lat - p["latitude"]) <= 0.001, f"Site latitude {p['latitude']}",
            f"found: {fmt(lat) if lat is not None else 'not set'}")
    r.check(lon is not None and abs(lon - p["longitude"]) <= 0.001, f"Site longitude {p['longitude']}",
            f"found: {fmt(lon) if lon is not None else 'not set'}")
    elev = site.RefElevation * m.scale if site and site.RefElevation is not None else None
    r.check(elev is not None and abs(elev - p["site_elevation"]) <= 0.5,
            f"Site elevation {p['site_elevation']} m above sea level",
            f"found: {fmt(elev) if elev is not None else 'not set'}")
    angle = None
    for ctx in m.by_type("IfcGeometricRepresentationContext"):
        tn = getattr(ctx, "TrueNorth", None)
        if tn is not None:
            x, y = tn.DirectionRatios[0], tn.DirectionRatios[1]
            angle = math.degrees(math.atan2(x, y))
            break
    hint = f"found: {fmt(angle) + ' degrees' if angle is not None else 'no true north in the model'}"
    if angle is not None and abs(angle + p["true_north_deg"]) <= 0.5:
        hint = ("found 12 degrees counter-clockwise; the brief asks for 12 degrees clockwise from project north, "
                "towards +X (FreeCAD: Declination -12; Bonsai: see the lesson)")
    r.check(angle is not None and abs(angle - p["true_north_deg"]) <= 0.5,
            f"True north {p['true_north_deg']:.0f} degrees clockwise from project north", hint)
    return r


@exercise("1.2", "Levels (building storeys)")
def ex_1_2(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("1.2", "Levels (building storeys)")
    found = {norm(n): (n, e) for n, e in m.storeys().items()}
    for name, elev in spec.STOREYS:
        hit = found.get(norm(name))
        r.check(hit is not None and same(hit[1], elev),
                f"Level '{name}' at {elev:+.3f}",
                "missing" if hit is None else f"found at {fmt(hit[1])}")
    extra = [n for k, (n, _) in found.items() if k not in {norm(s[0]) for s in spec.STOREYS}]
    r.check(not extra, "No extra levels", f"extra: {extra}")
    blds = m.by_type("IfcBuilding")
    inside = set()
    for b in blds:
        for rel in b.IsDecomposedBy or []:
            inside |= {o.id() for o in rel.RelatedObjects if o.is_a("IfcBuildingStorey")}
    r.check(m.by_type("IfcBuildingStorey") and all(s.id() in inside for s in m.by_type("IfcBuildingStorey")),
            "All levels belong to the building", "some levels are not inside the IfcBuilding")
    return r


def grid_axes(m):
    """World-coordinate line segments of every IfcGridAxis: {tag: [(p0, p1), ...]}."""
    out = {}
    for ax in m.by_type("IfcGridAxis"):
        grid = None
        for inv in ("PartOfU", "PartOfV", "PartOfW"):
            g = getattr(ax, inv, None)
            if g:
                grid = g[0]
                break
        M = np.eye(4)
        if grid is not None and grid.ObjectPlacement is not None:
            M = up.get_local_placement(grid.ObjectPlacement)
        pts = []
        curve = ax.AxisCurve
        if curve.is_a("IfcPolyline"):
            pts = [p.Coordinates for p in curve.Points]
        elif curve.is_a("IfcIndexedPolyCurve"):
            pts = list(curve.Points.CoordList)
        elif curve.is_a("IfcLine"):
            p0 = curve.Pnt.Coordinates
            d = curve.Dir.Orientation.DirectionRatios
            mag = curve.Dir.Magnitude
            pts = [p0, tuple(a + b * mag for a, b in zip(p0, d))]
        if len(pts) < 2:
            continue
        w = []
        for q in (pts[0], pts[-1]):
            q = list(q) + [0.0] * (3 - len(q))
            v = M @ np.array([q[0], q[1], q[2], 1.0])
            w.append(v[:3] * m.scale)
        out.setdefault(str(ax.AxisTag).strip(), []).append((w[0], w[1]))
    return out


@exercise("1.3", "Structural grid")
def ex_1_3(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("1.3", "Structural grid")
    axes = grid_axes(m)
    r.check(axes, "The model contains grid axes (IfcGridAxis)", "no grid axes found")
    ys, xs = list(spec.GRID_Y.values()), list(spec.GRID_X.values())
    for tag, x in spec.GRID_X.items():
        segs = axes.get(tag, [])
        ok = any(abs(p0[0] - x) <= POS and abs(p1[0] - x) <= POS and abs(p0[1] - p1[1]) >= (max(ys) - min(ys))
                 for p0, p1 in segs)
        r.check(ok, f"Axis {tag}: line parallel to Y at x = {x:.3f}, spanning grids 1 to 3",
                "missing" if not segs else f"found: {[(fmt(a[0]), fmt(a[1]), fmt(b[0]), fmt(b[1])) for a, b in segs]}")
    for tag, y in spec.GRID_Y.items():
        segs = axes.get(tag, [])
        ok = any(abs(p0[1] - y) <= POS and abs(p1[1] - y) <= POS and abs(p0[0] - p1[0]) >= (max(xs) - min(xs))
                 for p0, p1 in segs)
        r.check(ok, f"Axis {tag}: line parallel to X at y = {y:.3f}, spanning grids A to D",
                "missing" if not segs else f"found: {[(fmt(a[0]), fmt(a[1]), fmt(b[0]), fmt(b[1])) for a, b in segs]}")
    return r

"""Section 2: columns, core walls, slab, beams, and clean joints."""
import itertools

from .. import spec
from ..core import Model, Result, norm, same, fmt, match_by_position, raster_area, plan_center, TOL
from . import exercise


def _in_storey(m, el, name):
    c = m.container(el)
    return c is not None and norm(c.Name) == norm(name)


def check_columns(m, r):
    cols = m.elements("IfcColumn")
    marks = spec.column_marks()
    ground = [c for c in cols if m.bbox(c) is not None and m.bbox(c)[2] < 1.0]
    r.check(len(ground) == len(marks), f"{len(marks)} columns between Level 0 and Level 1",
            f"found {len(ground)}")
    found = match_by_position(m, ground, marks)
    missing = [k for k, v in found.items() if v is None]
    r.check(not missing, "One column at every grid intersection", f"missing at: {missing}")
    s, c = spec.COLUMN["size"], spec.COLUMN
    bad_size, bad_z, bad_name, bad_storey = [], [], [], []
    for mark, el in found.items():
        if el is None:
            continue
        bb = m.bbox(el)
        if not (same(bb[3] - bb[0], s) and same(bb[4] - bb[1], s)):
            bad_size.append(f"{mark} {fmt(bb[3]-bb[0])}x{fmt(bb[4]-bb[1])}")
        if not (same(bb[2], c["z0"]) and same(bb[5], c["z1"])):
            bad_z.append(f"{mark} {fmt(bb[2])} to {fmt(bb[5])}")
        if norm(el.Name) != norm(mark):
            bad_name.append(f"{mark} named '{el.Name}'")
        if not _in_storey(m, el, "Level 0"):
            bad_storey.append(mark)
    more = lambda xs: "; ".join(xs[:3]) + (f" ... ({len(xs)} columns)" if len(xs) > 3 else "")  # noqa: E731
    r.check(not bad_size, f"Columns are {int(s*1000)} x {int(s*1000)} mm", more(bad_size))
    r.check(not bad_z, f"Columns run from {c['z0']:+.3f} to the slab soffit {c['z1']:+.3f}", more(bad_z))
    r.check(not bad_name, "Columns are named by grid (C-A1 ... C-D3)", "; ".join(bad_name[:6]))
    r.check(not bad_storey, "Columns belong to Level 0", f"not in Level 0: {bad_storey}")
    return found


@exercise("2.1", "Columns")
def ex_2_1(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("2.1", "Columns")
    check_columns(m, r)
    return r


def wall_boxes(m):
    out = []
    for w in m.elements("IfcWall"):
        bb = m.bbox(w)
        if bb is not None:
            out.append((w, bb))
    return out


@exercise("2.2", "Core walls traced from the architect's model", inputs=("model.ifc", "[architect_model.ifc]"))
def ex_2_2(path, architect=None):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("2.2", "Core walls traced from the architect's model")
    c = spec.CORE
    walls = wall_boxes(m)
    r.check(walls, "The model contains walls (IfcWall)", "no walls found")
    if not walls:
        return r
    target = list(spec.core_walls().values())
    if architect:
        a = Model(architect)
        lb = [w for w in a.elements("IfcWall") if a.find_prop(w, "LoadBearing") in (True, "True", "TRUE")]
        target = [tuple(a.bbox(w)[[0, 1, 3, 4]]) for w in lb if a.bbox(w) is not None]
        r.check(len(lb) == 4, "Architect's model read: 4 load-bearing walls", f"found {len(lb)}")
    plan = [(bb[0], bb[1], bb[3], bb[4]) for _, bb in walls]
    want_area, got_area = raster_area(target), raster_area(plan)
    r.check(abs(got_area - want_area) <= 0.03 * want_area,
            f"Wall footprint matches the core: {want_area:.2f} m2", f"your walls cover {got_area:.2f} m2")
    xs0, ys0 = min(p[0] for p in plan), min(p[1] for p in plan)
    xs1, ys1 = max(p[2] for p in plan), max(p[3] for p in plan)
    ok = all(abs(a - b) <= 0.02 for a, b in zip((xs0, ys0, xs1, ys1), (c["x0"], c["y0"], c["x1"], c["y1"])))
    r.check(ok, f"Core outline x {c['x0']} to {c['x1']}, y {c['y0']} to {c['y1']}",
            f"found x {fmt(xs0)} to {fmt(xs1)}, y {fmt(ys0)} to {fmt(ys1)}")
    thin = [min(bb[3] - bb[0], bb[4] - bb[1]) for _, bb in walls]
    r.check(all(same(t, c["t"]) for t in thin), f"Walls are {int(c['t']*1000)} mm thick",
            f"thicknesses: {[fmt(t) for t in thin]}")
    r.check(all(same(bb[2], c["z0"]) and same(bb[5], c["z1"]) for _, bb in walls),
            f"Walls run from {c['z0']:+.3f} to the slab soffit {c['z1']:+.3f}",
            f"found: {[(fmt(bb[2]), fmt(bb[5])) for _, bb in walls]}")
    lb_ok = [w for w, _ in walls if m.find_prop(w, "LoadBearing") in (True, "True", "TRUE", 1)]
    r.check(len(lb_ok) == len(walls), "Every core wall is marked load-bearing (LoadBearing = True)",
            f"{len(walls) - len(lb_ok)} wall(s) without LoadBearing = True")
    r.check(all(_in_storey(m, w, "Level 0") for w, _ in walls), "Walls belong to Level 0", "")
    return r


def check_slab(m, r):
    s = spec.SLAB
    slabs = [e for e in m.elements("IfcSlab") if m.bbox(e) is not None and 3.0 < m.bbox(e)[5] < 4.0]
    r.check(len(slabs) == 1, "One slab at Level 1", f"found {len(slabs)}")
    if not slabs:
        return None
    sl = slabs[0]
    bb = m.bbox(sl)
    ok = all(abs(a - b) <= 0.02 for a, b in zip(bb, (s["x0"], s["y0"], s["z0"], s["x1"], s["y1"], s["z1"])))
    r.check(ok, f"Slab edges at the outer column faces (x {s['x0']} to {s['x1']}, y {s['y0']} to {s['y1']}), "
                f"top {s['z1']:+.3f}, soffit {s['z0']:+.3f}",
            f"found x {fmt(bb[0])} to {fmt(bb[3])}, y {fmt(bb[1])} to {fmt(bb[4])}, z {fmt(bb[2])} to {fmt(bb[5])}")
    want, got = spec.slab_volume(), m.volume(sl)
    full = (s["x1"] - s["x0"]) * (s["y1"] - s["y0"]) * spec.SLAB_T
    r.check(abs(got - want) <= 0.01 * want,
            f"Slab volume {want:.2f} m3, with the core and stair openings cut",
            f"found {got:.2f} m3" + (" (the openings are missing)" if abs(got - full) < 0.01 * full else ""))
    r.check(_in_storey(m, sl, "Level 1"), "Slab belongs to Level 1",
            f"in: {m.container(sl).Name if m.container(sl) else 'no level'}")
    return sl


@exercise("2.3", "Level 1 slab with openings")
def ex_2_3(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("2.3", "Level 1 slab with openings")
    check_slab(m, r)
    return r


def check_beams(m, r):
    b = spec.BEAM
    want = spec.beams()
    beams = [e for e in m.elements("IfcBeam") if m.bbox(e) is not None]
    r.check(len(beams) == len(want), f"{len(want)} beams at Level 1", f"found {len(beams)}")
    centres = {k: ((x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2) for k, (x0, y0, x1, y1) in want.items()}
    found = match_by_position(m, beams, centres, tol=0.05)
    missing = [k for k, v in found.items() if v is None]
    r.check(not missing, "A beam on every grid line between columns", f"missing: {missing}")
    bad_box, bad_name, bad_storey = [], [], []
    for mark, el in found.items():
        if el is None:
            continue
        bb = m.bbox(el)
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = want[mark]
        if not all(abs(a - t) <= TOL for a, t in zip(bb, (x0, y0, b["z0"], x1, y1, b["z1"]))):
            bad_box.append(f"{mark}: x {fmt(bb[0])}-{fmt(bb[3])} y {fmt(bb[1])}-{fmt(bb[4])} z {fmt(bb[2])}-{fmt(bb[5])}")
        if norm(el.Name) != norm(mark):
            bad_name.append(f"{mark} named '{el.Name}'")
        if not _in_storey(m, el, "Level 1"):
            bad_storey.append(mark)
    r.check(not bad_box, f"Beams are {int(b['b']*1000)} wide x {int(b['h']*1000)} deep below the soffit "
                         f"({b['z0']:+.3f} to {b['z1']:+.3f}) and stop at the column faces", "; ".join(bad_box[:4]))
    r.check(not bad_name, "Beams are named by grid line and bay (B-1/AB ...)", "; ".join(bad_name[:6]))
    r.check(not bad_storey, "Beams belong to Level 1", f"not in Level 1: {bad_storey[:6]}")
    return found


@exercise("2.4", "Level 1 beams")
def ex_2_4(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("2.4", "Level 1 beams")
    check_beams(m, r)
    return r


def _overlap(a, b):
    dx = min(a[3], b[3]) - max(a[0], b[0])
    dy = min(a[4], b[4]) - max(a[1], b[1])
    dz = min(a[5], b[5]) - max(a[2], b[2])
    return dx * dy * dz if dx > 0 and dy > 0 and dz > 0 else 0.0


def _mesh_overlap(m, a, b, ba, bb, n=10):
    """Approximate overlap volume of two solids: sample the intersection of their boxes."""
    import numpy as np
    from .s7_management import _points_in_mesh
    lo = np.maximum(ba[:3], bb[:3])
    hi = np.minimum(ba[3:], bb[3:])
    axes = [np.linspace(lo[i], hi[i], n + 2)[1:-1] for i in range(3)]
    pts = np.stack(np.meshgrid(*axes, indexing="ij"), -1).reshape(-1, 3) + np.array([1e-4, 2.3e-4, 3.1e-4])
    va, fa = m.mesh(a)
    vb, fb = m.mesh(b)
    inside = _points_in_mesh(pts, va, fa) & _points_in_mesh(pts, vb, fb)
    return inside.mean() * float(np.prod(hi - lo))


def frame_volumes():
    c, b, w = spec.COLUMN, spec.BEAM, spec.CORE
    col = len(spec.column_marks()) * c["size"] ** 2 * (c["z1"] - c["z0"])
    beam = sum((x1 - x0) * (y1 - y0) for x0, y0, x1, y1 in spec.beams().values()) * b["h"]
    wall = raster_area(list(spec.core_walls().values())) * (w["z1"] - w["z0"])
    return {"IfcColumn": col, "IfcBeam": beam, "IfcWall": wall, "IfcSlab": spec.slab_volume()}


@exercise("2.5", "Clean joints: no element counted twice")
def ex_2_5(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("2.5", "Clean joints: no element counted twice")
    classes = ["IfcColumn", "IfcBeam", "IfcWall", "IfcSlab"]
    els = [(e, m.bbox(e)) for cl in classes for e in m.elements(cl) if m.bbox(e) is not None]
    els = [(e, bb) for e, bb in els if bb[2] > -0.5 and bb[5] < 4.0]
    clashes = []
    for (a, ba), (b, bb) in itertools.combinations(els, 2):
        ov = _overlap(ba, bb)
        if ov > 0.001:   # the boxes overlap; measure the real overlap (mitred corners overlap only as boxes)
            ov = _mesh_overlap(m, a, b, ba, bb)
        if ov > 0.001:
            clashes.append(f"{a.Name} / {b.Name}: {ov*1000:.0f} litres")
    r.check(not clashes, "No two elements overlap (beams stop at column faces, columns and walls stop at the soffit)",
            "; ".join(clashes[:6]) + (f" ... and {len(clashes)-6} more" if len(clashes) > 6 else ""))
    want = frame_volumes()
    for cl in classes:
        got = sum(m.volume(e) for e, bb in els if e.is_a(cl))
        r.check(abs(got - want[cl]) <= 0.01 * want[cl] + 0.01,
                f"Concrete volume of {cl[3:].lower()}s {want[cl]:.2f} m3", f"found {got:.2f} m3")
    total = sum(want.values())
    got = sum(m.volume(e) for e, _ in els)
    r.check(abs(got - total) <= 0.01 * total, f"Total frame concrete {total:.2f} m3", f"found {got:.2f} m3")
    return r

"""Section 3: stair, footings, piles, reinforcement, materials, groups."""
import math

from .. import spec
from ..core import Model, Result, norm, same, fmt, match_by_position, has_material, plan_center, predefined_type
from . import exercise
from .s2_structure import _in_storey


@exercise("3.1", "Stair from Level 0 to Level 1")
def ex_3_1(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("3.1", "Stair from Level 0 to Level 1")
    st = spec.STAIR
    parts = [e for e in m.by_type("IfcStair") + m.by_type("IfcStairFlight") if m.bbox(e) is not None]
    r.check(parts, "The model contains a stair (IfcStair or IfcStairFlight)", "none found")
    if not parts:
        return r
    bbs = [m.bbox(e) for e in parts]
    x0, y0, z0 = min(b[0] for b in bbs), min(b[1] for b in bbs), min(b[2] for b in bbs)
    x1, y1, z1 = max(b[3] for b in bbs), max(b[4] for b in bbs), max(b[5] for b in bbs)
    r.check(abs(x0 - st["x0"]) <= 0.05 and abs(x1 - st["x1"]) <= 0.05,
            f"Stair width {st['x1']-st['x0']:.2f} m between x {st['x0']} and {st['x1']}", f"found x {fmt(x0)} to {fmt(x1)}")
    r.check(abs(y0 - st["y0"]) <= 0.05 and st["y1"] - 0.15 <= y1 <= 6.4 + 0.01,
            f"Stair starts at y {st['y0']} and lands inside the slab opening (y up to 6.4)", f"found y {fmt(y0)} to {fmt(y1)}")
    n = h = None
    for e in parts:
        n = n or m.find_prop(e, "NumberOfRiser") or m.find_prop(e, "NumberOfRisers")
        h = h or m.find_prop(e, "RiserHeight")
    top_ok = abs(z1 - st["z1"]) <= 0.03
    if not top_ok and n is not None and int(n) == st["risers"]:
        # Some programs (FreeCAD's Stairs tool) end the flight at its last tread: the last riser is the
        # slab edge. Accepted only when the model says it has the full riser count.
        top_ok = abs(z1 - (st["z1"] - (st["z1"] - st["z0"]) / int(n))) <= 0.03
    r.check(top_ok, f"Stair rises to Level 1 ({st['z1']:+.3f})", f"top found at {fmt(z1)}")
    r.check(z0 >= -0.30 and z0 <= 0.05, "Stair starts at Level 0", f"bottom found at {fmt(z0)}")
    if n is not None:
        r.check(int(n) == st["risers"], f"{st['risers']} risers", f"found {n}")
    if h is not None:
        r.check(abs(float(h) * (m.scale if float(h) > 1 else 1) - st["riser"]) <= 0.005,
                f"Riser height {int(st['riser']*1000)} mm", f"found {h}")
    if n is None and h is None:
        r.check(True, "Riser count not stored in the model (optional); the rise was checked from the geometry")
    r.check(any(_in_storey(m, e, "Level 0") for e in parts), "Stair belongs to Level 0", "")
    return r


@exercise("3.2", "Pad footings")

def _host_bars(m, host_bb, bars):
    """All bar pieces whose centre lies inside the host's plan outline (and within its height + 1 m)."""
    out = []
    for b in bars:
        for bb in m.components(b):
            cx, cy = plan_center(bb)
            cz = (bb[2] + bb[5]) / 2
            if host_bb[0] - 0.01 <= cx <= host_bb[3] + 0.01 and host_bb[1] - 0.01 <= cy <= host_bb[4] + 0.01 \
                    and host_bb[2] - 1.0 <= cz <= host_bb[5] + 1.0:
                out.append(bb)
    return out


@exercise("3.4", "Reinforcement: column C-A1 and footing F-A1")
def ex_3_4(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("3.4", "Reinforcement: column C-A1 and footing F-A1")
    R = spec.REBAR
    bars = m.by_type("IfcReinforcingBar")
    r.check(bars, "The model contains reinforcing bars (IfcReinforcingBar)", "none found")
    if not bars:
        return r
    cols = match_by_position(m, [e for e in m.elements("IfcColumn") if m.bbox(e) is not None and m.bbox(e)[2] < 1],
                             {"C-A1": spec.column_marks()["C-A1"]})
    col = cols["C-A1"]
    rc = R["column"]
    if r.check(col is not None, "Column C-A1 found", "missing"):
        cb = m.bbox(col)
        pieces = _host_bars(m, cb, bars)
        longs = [b for b in pieces if (b[5] - b[2]) > 2.0 and max(b[3] - b[0], b[4] - b[1]) < 0.05]
        links = [b for b in pieces if (b[5] - b[2]) < 0.06 and min(b[3] - b[0], b[4] - b[1]) > 0.2]
        r.check(len(longs) == rc["long_n"], f"{rc['long_n']} vertical bars in C-A1", f"found {len(longs)}")
        if longs:
            d = sum(max(b[3] - b[0], b[4] - b[1]) for b in longs) / len(longs)
            r.check(abs(d - rc["long_d"]) <= 0.0015, f"Vertical bars Ø{int(rc['long_d']*1000)}", f"found Ø{d*1000:.1f}")
            want = rc["cover"] + rc["link_d"]
            gaps = [min(b[0] - cb[0], cb[3] - b[3], b[1] - cb[1], cb[4] - b[4]) for b in longs]
            r.check(all(abs(g - want) <= 0.004 for g in gaps),
                    f"Vertical bars {want*1000:.0f} mm from the column faces ({int(rc['cover']*1000)} cover + Ø{int(rc['link_d']*1000)} link)",
                    f"found {[round(g*1000) for g in gaps]} mm")
        span = (cb[5] - cb[2]) - 2 * 0.05
        n_expect = int(span / rc["link_s"]) + 1
        r.check(abs(len(links) - n_expect) <= 2, f"About {n_expect} links at {int(rc['link_s']*1000)} mm centres",
                f"found {len(links)}")
        if links:
            gaps = [min(b[0] - cb[0], cb[3] - b[3], b[1] - cb[1], cb[4] - b[4]) for b in links]
            r.check(all(abs(g - rc["cover"]) <= 0.004 for g in gaps), f"Links at {int(rc['cover']*1000)} mm cover",
                    f"found {sorted(set(round(g*1000) for g in gaps))} mm")
    foots = match_by_position(m, [e for e in m.elements("IfcFooting") if m.bbox(e) is not None],
                              {"F-A1": spec.column_marks()["C-A1"]})
    ft = foots["F-A1"]
    rf = R["footing"]
    if r.check(ft is not None, "Footing F-A1 found", "missing"):
        fb = m.bbox(ft)
        pieces = [b for b in _host_bars(m, fb, bars) if b[2] < fb[5] and b[5] > fb[2] and b[5] - b[2] < 0.05]
        xb = [b for b in pieces if (b[3] - b[0]) > 1.2]
        yb = [b for b in pieces if (b[4] - b[1]) > 1.2]
        n_expect = int((spec.FOOTING["size"] - 2 * rf["cover"] - rf["d"]) / rf["s"]) + 1
        r.check(abs(len(xb) - n_expect) <= 1 and abs(len(yb) - n_expect) <= 1,
                f"Bottom mesh: about {n_expect} bars each way at {int(rf['s']*1000)} mm",
                f"found {len(xb)} along X and {len(yb)} along Y")
        if pieces:
            d = sum(b[5] - b[2] for b in pieces) / len(pieces)
            r.check(abs(d - rf["d"]) <= 0.0015, f"Mesh bars Ø{int(rf['d']*1000)}", f"found Ø{d*1000:.1f}")
            low = min(b[2] for b in pieces) - fb[2]
            r.check(abs(low - rf["cover"]) <= 0.004, f"Bottom cover {int(rf['cover']*1000)} mm",
                    f"found {low*1000:.0f} mm")
    mats = [b for b in bars if not has_material(m.materials(b), R["steel"])]
    r.check(not mats, f"Bars have the material {R['steel']}", f"{len(mats)} bar object(s) without it")
    return r


def _concrete_targets():
    return {"IfcColumn": spec.COLUMN, "IfcBeam": spec.BEAM, "IfcSlab": spec.SLAB, "IfcWall": spec.CORE,
            "IfcPile": spec.PILES}


@exercise("3.5", "Materials and concrete data")
def ex_3_5(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("3.5", "Materials and concrete data")
    groups = dict(_concrete_targets())
    for cls, data in groups.items():
        els = [e for e in m.elements(cls) if m.bbox(e) is not None]
        _check_concrete(m, r, cls, els, data)
    feet = [e for e in m.elements("IfcFooting") if m.bbox(e) is not None]
    _check_concrete(m, r, "IfcFooting", feet, spec.FOOTING)
    return r


def _check_concrete(m, r, cls, els, data):
    if not els:
        r.check(False, f"{cls[3:]}s present", "none found")
        return
    no_mat = [e.Name for e in els if not has_material(m.materials(e), data["concrete"])]
    r.check(not no_mat, f"{cls[3:]}s: material {data['concrete']}", f"{len(no_mat)} without it, e.g. {no_mat[:3]}")
    bad = []
    for e in els:
        ps = m.psets(e).get("Pset_ConcreteElementGeneral", {})
        if norm(ps.get("StrengthClass")) != norm(data["concrete"]) or norm(ps.get("ExposureClass")) != norm(data["exposure"]):
            bad.append(e.Name)
    r.check(not bad, f"{cls[3:]}s: Pset_ConcreteElementGeneral StrengthClass {data['concrete']}, ExposureClass {data['exposure']}",
            f"{len(bad)} missing or wrong, e.g. {bad[:3]}")


@exercise("3.6", "Selection groups")

    for name, cls in spec.GROUPS.items():
        g = groups.get(norm(name))
        if not r.check(g is not None, f"Group '{name}' exists", f"groups found: {[x.Name for x in groups.values()]}"):
            continue
        members = set()
        for rel in g.IsGroupedBy or []:
            members |= {o.id() for o in rel.RelatedObjects}
        if cls == "IfcColumn":
            want = {e.id() for e in m.elements("IfcColumn") if m.bbox(e) is not None and m.bbox(e)[2] < 1}
        else:
            want = {e.id() for e in m.elements(cls)}
        r.check(want and members == want, f"'{name}' holds exactly the {len(want)} {cls[3:].lower()}s",
                f"{len(members & want)} of {len(want)} in the group, {len(members - want)} other element(s)")
    return r

"""Section 7: phases, design options, worksharing, model health, clashes, purge, templates, export."""

import ifcopenshell.util.element as ue

from .. import spec

STRUCTURAL = ("IfcColumn", "IfcBeam", "IfcSlab", "IfcWall", "IfcFooting", "IfcPile", "IfcStair", "IfcStairFlight")


def _status(m, e):
    v = m.find_prop(e, "Status")
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):   # an enumerated value (as Bonsai's Status panel writes it)
        v = v[0] if v else None
    return str(v).upper() if v is not None else None


@exercise("7.1", "Phases: existing, demolish, new", inputs=("renovation_model.ifc",))
def ex_7_1(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("7.1", "Phases: existing, demolish, new")
    els = [e for cl in STRUCTURAL for e in m.elements(cl) if e.Name]
    for prefix, status in (("E-", "EXISTING"), ("D-", "DEMOLISH")):
        group = [e for e in els if e.Name.upper().startswith(prefix)]
        bad = [e.Name for e in group if _status(m, e) != status]
        r.check(group and not bad, f"Elements named {prefix}... have Status = {status}",
                f"{len(bad)} of {len(group)} wrong: {bad[:4]}" if group else "no such elements found")
    new = [e for e in els if e.Name.upper().startswith("N-")]
    r.check(new, "The new beam N-B1 is modelled", "no element named N-... found")
    for e in new:
        bb = m.bbox(e)
        r.check(_status(m, e) == "NEW", f"{e.Name} has Status = NEW", f"found {_status(m, e)}")
        ok = bb is not None and abs(bb[0] - 0.2) <= 0.03 and abs(bb[3] - 5.8) <= 0.03 and abs(bb[1] + 0.15) <= 0.03 \
            and abs(bb[4] - 0.15) <= 0.03 and abs(bb[2] - 2.75) <= 0.03 and abs(bb[5] - 3.35) <= 0.03
        r.check(ok, f"{e.Name} is 300 x 600 between columns E-A1 and E-B1 (x 0.2 to 5.8, z +2.750 to +3.350)",
                f"found {[fmt(v) for v in bb] if bb is not None else 'no geometry'}")
    return r


def _boxes(m):
    out = []
    for cl in STRUCTURAL:
        for e in m.elements(cl):
            bb = m.bbox(e)
            if bb is not None:
                out.append((e, tuple(np.round(bb, 2))))
    return out

    els = [e for cl in STRUCTURAL for e in m.elements(cl) if m.bbox(e) is not None]
    seen, dups = {}, []
    for e in els:
        key = (e.is_a(), tuple(np.round(m.bbox(e), 2)))
        if key in seen:
            dups.append(f"{e.Name} = {seen[key].Name}")
        seen[key] = e
    r.check(not dups, "No duplicate elements in the same place", "; ".join(dups[:5]))
    loose = [e.Name or e.GlobalId for e in els if m.container(e) is None]

    nomat = [e.Name or e.GlobalId for e in els if not m.materials(e)]
    r.check(not nomat, "Every element has a material", f"no material: {nomat[:5]}")
    noname = [e.GlobalId for e in els if not (e.Name or "").strip()]
    r.check(not noname, "Every element has a name (mark)", f"{len(noname)} without a name")
    r.check(len(els) >= 20, "The model still holds the frame (nothing important deleted)", f"only {len(els)} elements left")
    return r


def _points_in_mesh(pts, v, f):
    """Ray parity test (+X ray) for many points against one closed mesh."""
    a, b, c = v[f[:, 0]], v[f[:, 1]], v[f[:, 2]]
    e1, e2 = b - a, c - a
    d = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    h = np.cross(np.broadcast_to(d, e2.shape), e2)
    det = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", e1, h)
    good = np.abs(det) > 1e-12
    inside = np.zeros(len(pts), bool)
    for k, p in enumerate(pts):
        s = p - a
        u = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", s, h) / np.where(good, det, 1)
        q = np.cross(s, e1)
        vv = (q @ d) / np.where(good, det, 1)
        t = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", e2, q) / np.where(good, det, 1)
        hit = good & (u >= 0) & (vv >= 0) & (u + vv <= 1) & (t > 1e-9)
        inside[k] = hit.sum() % 2 == 1
    return inside


def _sample(box, n=6):
    xs = np.linspace(box[0], box[3], n)
    ys = np.linspace(box[1], box[4], n)
    zs = np.linspace(box[2], box[5], n)
    g = np.stack(np.meshgrid(xs, ys, zs, indexing="ij"), -1).reshape(-1, 3)
    return g + np.array([1e-4, 2.3e-4, 3.1e-4])   # avoid hitting edges exactly


def _inter(a, b, grow=0.0):
    lo = np.maximum(a[:3] - grow, b[:3])
    hi = np.minimum(a[3:] + grow, b[3:])
    return np.concatenate([lo, hi]) if np.all(hi > lo) else None


@exercise("7.5", "Clash detection with the MEP model", inputs=("structure.ifc", "mep_model.ifc"))
def ex_7_5(struct_path, mep_path):
    s, mp = Model(struct_path), Model(mep_path)
    r = Result("7.5", "Clash detection with the MEP model")
    mep = [e for e in mp.by_type("IfcFlowSegment") + mp.by_type("IfcDuctSegment") + mp.by_type("IfcPipeSegment")
           if mp.bbox(e) is not None]
    mep = list({e.id(): e for e in mep}.values())
    r.check(mep, "MEP model read", "no duct or pipe segments found in the MEP file")
    els = [e for cl in ("IfcBeam", "IfcWall", "IfcColumn", "IfcSlab") for e in s.elements(cl) if s.bbox(e) is not None]
    hard, soft = [], []
    for d in mep:
        db = mp.bbox(d)
        for e in els:
            eb = s.bbox(e)
            box = _inter(db, eb)
            if box is not None:
                v, f = s.mesh(e)
                if _points_in_mesh(_sample(box), v, f).any():
                    hard.append(f"{d.Name} x {e.Name}")
                    continue
            box = _inter(db, eb, grow=0.025)
            if box is not None:
                v, f = s.mesh(e)
                if _points_in_mesh(_sample(box), v, f).any():
                    soft.append(f"{d.Name} x {e.Name}")
    r.check(not hard, "No hard clashes: every duct passes through an opening", "; ".join(hard[:6]))
    r.check(not soft, "At least 25 mm clearance around every duct", "; ".join(soft[:6]))
    beams = {e.Name: e for e in s.elements("IfcBeam")}
    full = spec.BEAM["b"] * spec.BEAM["h"]
    weak = []
    for name, (x0, y0, x1, y1) in spec.beams().items():
        e = beams.get(name)
        if e is None:
            continue
        length = max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
        if s.volume(e) < 0.9 * full * length:
            weak.append(name)
    r.check(not weak, "Openings are local (each beam keeps at least 90% of its volume)", f"too much removed from: {weak}")
    openings = s.by_type("IfcOpeningElement")
    r.check(openings, "Openings are modelled as IFC openings (IfcOpeningElement)", "no openings found")
    return r


@exercise("7.6", "Purge unused data", inputs=("purged_model.ifc",))
def ex_7_6(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("7.6", "Purge unused data")
    from .s4_types import read_catalogue
    keep = {norm(row["Name"]) for row in read_catalogue()}
    unused_types = [t.Name for t in m.by_type("IfcElementType") if not ue.get_types(t) and norm(t.Name) not in keep]
    r.check(not unused_types, "No unused types (the column types of the project catalogue may stay)",
            f"unused: {unused_types[:6]}")
    unused_mats = [x.Name for x in m.by_type("IfcMaterial") if m.f.get_total_inverses(x) == 0]
    r.check(not unused_mats, "No unused materials", f"unused: {unused_mats[:6]}")
    unused_prof = [p.ProfileName or p.is_a() for p in m.by_type("IfcProfileDef") if m.f.get_total_inverses(p) == 0]
    r.check(not unused_prof, "No unused profiles", f"unused: {unused_prof[:6]}")
    empty_groups = [g.Name for g in m.by_type("IfcGroup") if not any(rel.RelatedObjects for rel in (g.IsGroupedBy or []))]
    r.check(not empty_groups, "No empty groups", f"empty: {empty_groups}")
    r.check(len(m.elements("IfcColumn")) >= 12, "The used elements are still there", "columns were deleted")
    return r


@exercise("7.7", "Project library (template)", inputs=("template.ifc",))
def ex_7_7(path):

@exercise("7.8", "Export for issue: IFC4, levels, base quantities", inputs=("model.ifc",))
def ex_7_8(path):
    m = Model(path)
    r = Result("7.8", "Export for issue: IFC4, levels, base quantities")
    r.check(m.f.schema in ("IFC4", "IFC4X3", "IFC4X3_ADD2"), "Schema IFC4 (or IFC4.3)", f"found {m.f.schema}")
    lu = [u for u in m.by_type("IfcSIUnit") if u.UnitType == "LENGTHUNIT"]
    r.check(lu and lu[0].Name == "METRE", "SI length unit", "")
    els = [e for cl in STRUCTURAL for e in m.elements(cl) if m.bbox(e) is not None]
    r.check(len(els) >= 40, "The full TB-01 model is in the file", f"only {len(els)} elements")
    loose = [e.Name for e in els if m.container(e) is None]
    r.check(not loose, "Every element belongs to a level", f"{len(loose)} without a level")
    bad = []
    for e in [x for x in els if x.is_a() in ("IfcColumn", "IfcBeam", "IfcSlab", "IfcWall", "IfcFooting")]:
        q = None
        for name, ps in m.psets(e).items():
            if name.startswith("Qto_") and name.endswith("BaseQuantities"):
                q = ps.get("NetVolume") or ps.get("GrossVolume")
        if q is None or abs(float(q) * (m.scale ** 3 if float(q) > 1e5 else 1) - m.volume(e)) > 0.02 * m.volume(e) + 0.001:
            bad.append(e.Name)
    r.check(not bad, "Base quantities (Qto_...BaseQuantities volume) on every concrete element, matching the geometry",
            f"{len(bad)} missing or wrong, e.g. {bad[:4]}")
    return r
